fem_toolbox.documentation:
Finite-element research tools for verified 3D multiphysics simulations.

Stable stationary user APIs and their validity limits are documented in the
public API contract. Internal research building blocks may evolve separately.

fem_toolbox.adaptive.documentation: Controlled stationary Tet4 heat adaptation with inherited problem data.

AdaptiveOptions.documentation:
Indicator tolerance sqrt(W K), active DOFs and number of solved meshes.

Stagnation means eta fails to fall by min_reduction over stagnation_window
successive refinements. Tolerance is heuristic, never a certified error bound.

HeatProblem.documentation:
Stationary SI data. Boundary keys are INPUT triangle row indices.

Dirichlet values (K) may be scalar or point callable. Unlisted facets are
insulated. Cellwise material and all facet maps inherit exactly through
refinement parents; callable fields are reevaluated at physical points.
Point-only constraints are deliberately excluded from this workflow.

mesh_record.documentation: Canonical topology/selection record; hash includes external identity.

AdaptiveStage.documentation: Solved immutable mesh/result plus decision and parent evidence.

export.documentation:
Write deterministic strict JSON evidence (meshes and raw SI results).

This records discrete results and solver input fingerprints. Rerunning
callable data requires the original problem script, as for solve_heat.

solve_adaptive_heat.parameters: mesh: Mesh, problem: HeatProblem, options: AdaptiveOptions | None=None, *, remesher: Callable[..., Refinement]=refine_tet4
solve_adaptive_heat.documentation:
Solve-estimate-mark-refine until tolerance, budget, stagnation or error.

No partial or overbudget mesh is accepted. Validation/solver/adapter failures
return error with previous solved stages intact; programming errors propagate.
The remesher hook must return exact parent inheritance and conforming Tet4
geometry, obey max_points, and preserve domain/groups (see refinement ADR).

fem_toolbox.assembly.documentation:
Physics-independent COO assembly and preserved original linear systems.

Local vectors already include integration and the weak-form sign. Matrix and
vector entries use the SI units of their respective equations.

indices.documentation: Validate a one-dimensional sequence of nonnegative integer indices.

real_array.documentation: Copy finite real data with the required shape; reject complex values.

MatrixBlock.documentation: Local matrix (nrow, ncol) with separate global row/column DOFs.

VectorBlock.documentation: Integrated local load (ndof,); repeated DOFs accumulate.

LinearSystem.documentation: Owned sparse matrix and RHS; accessors return independent copies.

__init__.parameters: self, matrix: sparse.spmatrix, rhs: ArrayLike

residual.documentation: Return K x - f in equation units, including constrained reactions.

assemble.parameters: size: int, matrices: Iterable[MatrixBlock], vectors: Iterable[VectorBlock]=(), *, format: Literal['csr', 'csc']='csr'
assemble.documentation:
Sum local blocks through COO into CSR/CSC; no inactive DOFs are added.

Invalid shapes, indices or nonfinite values raise ValidationError. Empty
systems and repeated indices are supported. No symmetry is assumed.

fem_toolbox.boundary.documentation: Symmetry-preserving Dirichlet elimination on a copy of a linear system.

Dirichlet.documentation:
Global DOFs and prescribed SI field values, each shape (n,).

Resolve field selections with DofMap.indices; evaluate spatial/time callables
before constructing this algebraic condition. Duplicate values must agree
exactly; no implicit unit-dependent conflict tolerance is applied.

eliminate_dirichlet.documentation:
Return P K P + I_fixed and P(f-K g)+g; preserve original reactions.

P selects free DOFs and g holds prescribed values (zero elsewhere). Both
rows and columns are eliminated, so symmetry is retained. No solve occurs.

fem_toolbox.boundary.electrodes.documentation: Conducting equipotential boundaries for quasistatic electric fields.

Electrode.documentation:
Named exterior Triangle3/Triangle6 set with fixed potential (V) or total charge (C).

``facets`` is a named mesh facet set or active surface row indices. Exactly one
of ``potential`` and ``charge`` must be supplied. A floating open-circuit
electrode has ``charge=0``; no potential reference is inferred.

ElectrodeState.documentation: Solved common electrode potential (V) and adjacent conductor charge (C).

fem_toolbox.cfd.documentation: Experimental CFD operators, separate from the stable FEM Model API.

fem_toolbox.cfd.channel.documentation: Conservative fully developed channel momentum operator in SI units.

ChannelResult.documentation: Cell velocities and face shear; flow per unit span, power per wall area.

solve_channel.parameters: *, faces_m: ArrayLike, viscosity_Pa_s: float, pressure_gradient_Pa_m: float, wall_velocities_m_s: tuple[float, float]=(0.0, 0.0)
solve_channel.documentation:
Solve -(mu u')'=-dp/dx with two prescribed wall velocities.

faces_m has shape (n+1,), strictly increasing finite positions in m.
Constant viscosity is positive (Pa s); pressure gradient may have either
sign (Pa/m). Wall velocities are ordered lower/upper (m/s).
Reject invalid data or numerically unresolved conservation with
ValidationError. This is a reduced verification operator, not a RANS solver.

fem_toolbox.cfd.flow.documentation: Stationary incompressible Navier-Stokes reference with Oseen/Picard steps.

StationaryFlowResult.documentation:
Immutable MAC solution and independently reconstructed SI diagnostics.

u[ny,nx+1], v[ny+1,nx], p/divergence[ny,nx]. Momentum residuals live
on free velocity faces; mass/power quantities are per unit span.

solve_stationary_flow.parameters: grid: CartesianFluidGrid, fluid: IncompressibleFluid, boundary: ChannelBoundary | ClosedWalls, *, force_x_N_m3: ArrayLike=0.0, force_y_N_m3: ArrayLike=0.0, pressure_reference_Pa: float | None=None, relaxation: float=0.7, convection_scheme: str='donor-cell', max_iterations: int=200, relative_tolerance: float=1e-10, momentum_tolerance_N_m3: float=1e-12, mass_tolerance_kg_s: float=1e-12, power_tolerance_W_m: float=1e-12, max_unknowns: int=50000
solve_stationary_flow.documentation:
Solve conservative steady 2D incompressible flow in SI units.

Select donor-cell, linear-upwind (minmod deferred correction), or central
(face Peclet <2). Constant material, monolithic pressure coupling and
underrelaxed Picard iteration. ClosedWalls use p[0,0] as gauge (default 0).
ChannelBoundary uses prescribed outlet pressure and rejects any extra gauge.
Forces: scalar or free-face arrays u:(ny,nx-1) closed/(ny,nx) channel,
v:(ny-1,nx). Gates test final nonlinear momentum, local/global mass and work.
Raise ValidationError on unsupported backflow, invalid data, unresolved
scales, linear solve failure or nonconvergence (with last residual).

fem_toolbox.cfd.flow_config.documentation: Strict versioned TOML for the supported uniform stationary-flow contract.

FlowProblem.documentation: Validated grid, fluid and boundary data; reproducible zero-body-force run.

from_file.documentation: Read UTF-8 TOML and diagnose unreadable files/syntax as schema errors.

to_document.documentation: Detached schema-1 data; values and field names explicitly use SI.

solve.documentation: Solve with documented default controls; custom controls use Python API.

fem_toolbox.cfd.flow_model.documentation: Validated uniform fluid mesh, SI material and explicit boundary contracts.

CartesianFluidGrid.documentation: Uniform rectangle: cells=(nx,ny)>=2, size_m=(Lx,Ly)>0 in metres.

IncompressibleFluid.documentation: Constant density kg/m³ and dynamic viscosity Pa s, both positive.

ClosedWalls.documentation: Zero normal speed; constant bottom/top/left/right tangential speeds m/s.

ChannelBoundary.documentation:
Left u(y)>=0 inlet, v=0; right prescribed pressure and zero du/dn.

Profile shape is (ny,), owned and read-only; top/bottom are no-slip.
Reverse flow at the right outlet is unsupported and explicitly rejected.

__init__.parameters: self, inlet_velocity_m_s: ArrayLike, outlet_pressure_Pa: float=0

fem_toolbox.cfd.fluid_domain.documentation: Experimental mesh/BC/material preflight, deliberately without a CFD solver.

FluidDomain.documentation:
Immutable SI mesh/material/BC preflight, not a RANS solve.

Boundary indices refer to input line2 rows. Inlet velocity=(2,) or
(nselection,2) m/s; nu_tilde scalar or (nselection,) m²/s. Periodic
translations and pressure drops are paired with opposite signs.
A single connected mesh needs one outlet group or one pressure gauge.
Width is explicit for conversion of planar fluxes to kg/s.

from_document.parameters: cls, document: Mapping[str, Any], *, mesh: FluidMesh2D

from_file.documentation: Read schema-1 JSON domain and mesh confined to the same input tree.

fem_toolbox.cfd.fluid_mesh.documentation: Experimental conforming 2D Quad4 fluid geometry and wall-resolution gates.

WallQuality.documentation: Distances in metres; boundary rows and growth refer to selected wall faces.

y_plus.parameters: self, *, density_kg_m3: float, viscosity_Pa_s: float, wall_shear_Pa: ArrayLike
y_plus.documentation: Evaluate actual wall shear, reject y+>1; no estimated shear default.

FluidMesh2D.documentation:
Owned SI Quad4 mesh; complete boundary rows, immutable named selections.

points=(n,2) metres, quad4=(nc,4) CCW, line2=(nb,2). Indices are
zero-based. Boundary row order is preserved; normals use cell ownership.
Validates positive geometry, conformity, overlap and ADR-049 FV gates.
This is a reference adapter, with no fluid solver or mesh motion.

__init__.parameters: self, points: ArrayLike, quad4: ArrayLike, line2: ArrayLike, boundary_sets: Mapping[str, ArrayLike], volume_sets: Mapping[str, ArrayLike] | None=None

boundary_normals.documentation: Outward normals in the input line2 row order.

from_file.documentation: Read UTF-8 schema-1 JSON; no implicit unit conversion or repair.

to_document.documentation: Return detached JSON-ready input data, preserving group order/indices.

wall_quality.documentation:
Compute exact segment distances and opposite-face layer growth.

At least one named wall selection is required. For the selected
structured Quad4 rows, trace opposite faces to the domain boundary;
outward normal layer growth greater than 1.2 is rejected with wall ID.

fem_toolbox.cfd.mac.documentation: Sparse MAC operators with conservative convection and pressure outlet.

MACSystem.documentation: Private assembly state: free velocity maps, boundary values and volumes.

fem_toolbox.cfd.quad_flow.documentation: Stationary laminar Quad-FV flow with Krylov-accelerated SIMPLE steps.

QuadFlowConvergenceError.documentation: Nonconvergence with immutable complete outer residual history.

__init__.parameters: self, history: list[tuple[float, ...]]

QuadFlowResult.documentation:
Immutable cell/face SI fields and freshly reconstructed diagnostics.

U[ncell,2], p[ncell], mass_flux[nface] in mesh.faces order. Pressure is
the periodic part plus gauge, if periodic driving is present. History
rows contain momentum, continuity, global mass, global momentum, power.

solve_quad_flow.parameters: domain: FluidDomain, *, velocity_scale_m_s: float, length_scale_m: float, force_N_m3: ArrayLike=(0.0, 0.0), viscosity_Pa_s: ArrayLike | None=None, boundary_viscosity_Pa_s: ArrayLike | None=None, pressure_reference_Pa: float | None=None, convection_scheme: str='donor-cell', velocity_relaxation: float=0.5, pressure_relaxation: float=0.5, max_iterations: int=500, max_simple_steps: int=500, max_unknowns: int=50000, model: str='laminar'
solve_quad_flow.documentation:
Solve explicit laminar incompressible Quad-FV flow (not SA/RANS/FSI).

Scales U_ref,L_ref are mandatory positive SI. Force is (2,) or (nc,2).
Optional positive mu/mub fields must be provided together, shapes (nc,)/(nb,)
or scalar. FluidDomain supplies fixed rho, width and physical boundaries.
Full variable symmetric stress, component pressure mobility, donor-cell,
central (|Pe|<2) or bounded linear-upwind; no implicit scheme substitution.
Sparse LU block solves with GMRES-accelerated SIMPLE pressure corrections.
Final absolute gates are those of Doc/71, no relaxed tolerance fallback.
ValidationError covers backflow, nonconvergence, scales and resource limits.

fem_toolbox.cfd.quad_fv.documentation: Conservative SI Quad-FV primitives; no flow solve or boundary orchestration.

FaceGradient.documentation:
Full corrected gradient and its compact/nonorthogonal normal parts.

Scalar: gradient[nface,2], normal parts[nface]. Vector: gradient[nface,k,2],
normal parts[nface,k]. Gradient last axis is spatial x/y.

StressFlux.documentation:
sigma=-pI+mu*(grad U+grad U^T); traction is outward from fluid.

stress_Pa[nface,2,2], traction_Pa[nface,2], face_force_N[nface,2],
cell_force_N[ncell,2]=integrated div(sigma). No body/convection terms.
Force on a structure is the negative fluid traction times face area.

QuadFVGeometry.documentation:
Immutable operators on a validated mesh, width in metres.

All face arrays follow mesh.faces; boundary arrays follow mesh.line2.
Periodic values must already represent the same periodic field (pressure
means its periodic part); affine pressure drops belong in the body force.
One periodic face is active, its partner stores the opposite flux.
No PDE solver, pressure gauge elimination or physical BC defaults.

__init__.parameters: self, mesh: FluidMesh2D, *, width_m: float, periodic_pairs: Mapping[int, int] | None=None, max_cells: int=50000

from_domain.documentation: Use validated domain width and boundary-row periodic partners only.

gradient.documentation:
Linear-exact cell gradient from centre and prescribed face samples.

Scalar input (nc,)/(nb,) -> (nc,2); k components -> (nc,k,2).
All boundary rows are supplied; periodic rows are validated but ignored.

face_values.documentation: Interpolate centre-to-face extrapolations; exact for affine fields.

face_gradient.documentation:
Over-relaxed directional correction with the same geometry as pressure.

g_face = g_bar + n*(delta_phi - g_bar dot delta_x)/(delta_x dot n).
Normal part is delta_phi/d_n - g_bar dot(delta_x-d_n*n)/d_n.

cell_balance.documentation:
Integrated outward balance, scalar or k-vector flux per mesh face.

Periodic alias must carry the exact negative master flux. No division
by volume: mass flux kg/s -> kg/s; face force N -> cell force N.

stress_flux.parameters: self, velocity_m_s: ArrayLike, boundary_velocity_m_s: ArrayLike, *, viscosity_Pa_s: ArrayLike, boundary_viscosity_Pa_s: ArrayLike, pressure_Pa: ArrayLike | None=None, boundary_pressure_Pa: ArrayLike | None=None
stress_flux.documentation:
Full symmetric Newton stress with linear-exact face mu and pressure.

U:(nc,2), Ub:(nb,2). mu: positive scalar/(nc,), mub:(nb,).
Both pressure arrays are optional together, default zero viscous-only.
No scalar Laplacian replacement; cross/shear terms retained.

pressure_correction_matrix.parameters: self, *, momentum_diagonal_kg_s: ArrayLike, density_kg_m3: float, pressure_boundary_indices: ArrayLike=()
pressure_correction_matrix.documentation:
Positive compact -div(rho*d*grad(pc)) block (kg/(Pa s)).

d=V/a from the *unrelaxed integrated* momentum diagonal (kg/s).
a accepts scalar, (ncell,) or component (ncell,2) diagonals; the latter
uses n.T @ diag(V/a) @ n for the common normal mobility.
No gauge: closed/periodic block has exactly the constant null mode.
Selected boundary line rows mean prescribed pc=0; other outer fluxes
fixed. Nonorthogonal correction is explicit through FaceGradient.
Returned sparse matrix is a detached mutable object.

rhie_chow_flux.parameters: self, velocity_m_s: ArrayLike, boundary_velocity_m_s: ArrayLike, pressure_Pa: ArrayLike, boundary_pressure_Pa: ArrayLike, *, momentum_diagonal_kg_s: ArrayLike, density_kg_m3: float, pressure_boundary_indices: ArrayLike=()
rhie_chow_flux.documentation:
Common face mass flux rho*A*(Uf + df*(gbar_p-gface_p)) dot n.

U (nc,2), p (nc,), explicit face boundary samples. Fixed outer fluxes
use prescribed U; only selected pressure boundaries receive RC coupling.
No relaxation applied here. Caller must supply consistent unrelaxed a.

fem_toolbox.cfd.quad_system.documentation: Sparse affine field maps and conservative Oseen/SIMPLE block assembly.

Map.documentation: Private affine field map; caller supplies already validated arrays.

sparse.parameters: rows: list[int], cols: list[int], data: list[float], shape: tuple[int, int]

QuadSystem.documentation: Internal maps preserve common face states, full stress and BC constraints.

__init__.parameters: self, domain: FluidDomain, mu: NDArray[np.float64], mub: NDArray[np.float64]

transport.parameters: self, flux: NDArray[np.float64], u: NDArray[np.float64], scheme: str

fem_toolbox.cfd.rans.documentation: Coupled stationary 2D SA-noft2/SIMPLE with fresh field and wall-resolution gates.

RansConvergenceError.documentation: Failed joint iteration with immutable last fields and complete history.

__init__.parameters: self, reason: str, history: list[tuple[float, ...]], u: NDArray[np.float64], p: NDArray[np.float64], a: NDArray[np.float64]

RansResult.documentation:
Joint solution: flow, SA cell fields and actual wall-resolution diagnostics.

History columns: max momentum N/m³, mass kg/(m³ s), SA m²/s²,
global mass kg/s, max global momentum N, power W, accepted SA alpha.
wall_y_plus follows domain.wall_quality.boundary_indices. No DNS/model or
FSI qualification is implied by convergence of these discrete equations.

solve_rans.parameters: domain: FluidDomain, *, initial_nu_tilde_m2_s: ArrayLike, velocity_scale_m_s: float, length_scale_m: float, force_N_m3: ArrayLike=(0.0, 0.0), pressure_reference_Pa: float | None=None, convection_scheme: str='linear-upwind', velocity_relaxation: float=0.5, pressure_relaxation: float=0.5, sa_relaxation: float=0.5, max_iterations: int=500, max_simple_steps: int=500, max_unknowns: int=50000
solve_rans.documentation:
Joint Picard iteration for physical wall-resolved SA-noft2 and momentum.

Only explicit SA-noft2 is solved: at least one initial cell must have a>0,
all must be nonnegative; no inferred laminar mode or viscosity cap. Width,
physical BCs, positive SI scales and all inlet SA data come from the caller.
The same conservative Rhie-Chow mass flux transports momentum and SA.
Frozen nonnegative destruction is implicit; all final coefficients,
stresses, sources and field/balance residuals are recomputed at the accepted
joint state. Positivity backtracking reduces U/p/a updates together.
Actual wall shear must satisfy y+<=1 and layer growth<=1.2. Failure retains
the last complete joint history and fields; no wall function is substituted.

fem_toolbox.cfd.sa_model.documentation:
SI point terms for SA-noft2 with the Allmaras S modification (TMR note 1c).

No trip, ft2, negative-SA extension, viscosity cap or implicit laminar switch.
The model r cap is exactly ten; a zero modified vorticity uses that same cap.

SATerms.documentation:
Immutable cell arrays; sources in m²/s², diffusivities in m²/s.

destruction_rate_s_inv times nu_tilde gives the nonnegative destruction
source. It is suitable for the frozen implicit sink in the scalar solve.
r and wall_function are dimensionless; modified vorticity has unit 1/s.

sa_terms.parameters: nu_tilde_m2_s: ArrayLike, *, velocity_gradient_s_inv: ArrayLike, gradient_nu_tilde_m_s: ArrayLike, wall_distance_m: ArrayLike, kinematic_viscosity_m2_s: float
sa_terms.documentation:
Evaluate the complete SA-noft2 source law at positive-distance cells.

a is (ncell,), grad(U) is (ncell,2,2) with [component,derivative],
grad(a) is (ncell,2), d is scalar or (ncell,). Molecular nu is a positive
scalar. Negative/nonfinite a, d<=0, boolean data and unrepresentable terms
raise ValidationError; no input or output is clipped to hide a failure.
Wall Dirichlet values a=0 are imposed separately, never evaluated at d=0.

positive_sa_update.parameters: previous_m2_s: ArrayLike, candidate_m2_s: ArrayLike, *, relaxation: float=0.5, max_attempts: int=20
positive_sa_update.documentation:
One common relaxed step, halved until finite and nonnegative everywhere.

Returns immutable state, accepted alpha and number of halvings. No component
is clipped. Failure identifies the last minimum and its zero-based cell.

fem_toolbox.cfd.sa_transport.documentation: Conservative stationary SA-noft2 scalar equation on the validated Quad-FV mesh.

SAConvergenceError.documentation: Nonconvergence retains the last nonnegative state and raw residual history.

__init__.parameters: self, history: list[float], state: NDArray[np.float64], reason: str

SATransportResult.documentation:
Immutable scalar solution for prescribed conservative flow; not a RANS solve.

Arrays: a/residual/wall distance are cell fields, boundary a follows line2,
and advective/diffusive fluxes follow mesh.faces (outward from owner).
Integrated fluxes and global balance have unit m^5/s². History is the
maximum absolute fresh cell residual in m²/s² at every accepted update.

solve_sa_transport.parameters: domain: FluidDomain, *, mass_flux_kg_s: ArrayLike, velocity_gradient_s_inv: ArrayLike, initial_nu_tilde_m2_s: ArrayLike, velocity_scale_m_s: float, length_scale_m: float, boundary_values_m2_s: ArrayLike | None=None, wall_distance_m: ArrayLike | None=None, source_m2_s2: ArrayLike=0.0, convection_scheme: str='linear-upwind', relaxation: float=0.5, max_iterations: int=500, max_cells: int=50000
solve_sa_transport.documentation:
Solve SA for frozen conservative flow with full fresh nonlinear residuals.

Boundary defaults: wall a=0, inlet explicit a, outlet/symmetry zero normal
derivative and periodic paired trace. Optional boundary and distance fields
are explicit manufactured-solution hooks, recorded as such in provenance;
they do not qualify physical wall resolution or a coupled RANS solution.
Destruction is a frozen nonnegative implicit sink. A common positivity line
search halves the relaxed candidate, at most twenty attempts, without state
clipping. Failure carries the latest history, state, minimum and cell ID.

fem_toolbox.cfd.stokes.documentation: Monolithic pressure/velocity coupling on a uniform closed 2D MAC grid.

StokesResult.documentation: Immutable SI fields; residuals include the omitted gauge-cell equation.

solve_stokes.parameters: *, cells: tuple[int, int], size_m: tuple[float, float], viscosity_Pa_s: float, force_x_N_m3: ArrayLike=0.0, force_y_N_m3: ArrayLike=0.0, tangential_wall_velocities_m_s: tuple[float, float, float, float]=(0, 0, 0, 0), pressure_reference_Pa: float=0.0, relative_tolerance: float=1e-10, max_unknowns: int=50000
solve_stokes.documentation:
Solve -mu Laplace(u)+grad(p)=f and div(u)=0 on a closed rectangle.

cells=(nx,ny), each >=2; size_m=(Lx,Ly)>0. Normal wall velocity is zero.
Tangential wall values are bottom/top/left/right in m/s. Forces are finite
scalars or interior-face arrays (ny,nx-1)/(ny-1,nx) in N/m³.
Pin p[0,0] to pressure_reference_Pa; this does not impose outlet pressure.
Return MAC fields u[ny,nx+1], v[ny+1,nx], p[ny,nx], including zero normal
boundaries. ValidationError diagnoses inputs, singular/range failures or
failed residual/conservation gates. No convection or turbulence model.

fem_toolbox.conventions.documentation:
Project-wide mathematical, component-ordering, and SI-unit conventions.

These values are executable counterparts of ``Doc/02_MATHEMATICAL_MODEL.md``.
Changing one is an architecture decision and requires corresponding documentation
and verification updates.

VoigtIndex.documentation: Indices for engineering-strain and stress vectors in three dimensions.

fem_toolbox.coupling.documentation: Experimental stationary planar fluid/structure interface operators.

fem_toolbox.coupling.interface.documentation:
Conservative P1 overlap quadrature on extruded planar fluid segments.

Coordinates are SI metres, traction Pa, integrated quadrature/nodal forces N.
The same interpolation matrix and its transpose define virtual-work pairing.
No nearest-neighbour assignment, extrapolation or geometry filling is used.

TransferAudit.documentation: Raw conservation errors (N, N m, J) and normalized project gate.

InterfaceLoads.documentation: Net structural nodal load, separated fluid/external contributions.

InterfaceMap.documentation:
Owned quadrature and scalar P1 matrix W; vector H=kron(W,I3).

Build using :func:`build_interface_map`. The matrix property returns a copy;
public numerical arrays use immutable bytes-backed storage. Arbitrary 3D
virtual displacements may be used for work audits. Physical mesh motion
additionally requires a span-invariant planar trace via the endpoint method.

interpolation_matrix.documentation: Return an independent vector interpolation matrix H (3nq,3ns).

interpolate.documentation: P1 structural displacement [nnode,3] to quadrature [nq,3], metres.

transfer_forces.documentation: Apply H transpose to integrated quadrature forces [nq,3] in N.

audit.parameters: self, integrated_forces_N: ArrayLike, virtual_displacement_m: ArrayLike | None=None
audit.documentation:
Check force, origin moments and optional virtual work, unchanged gates.

Relative gate is 1e-10, with absolute floors 1e-12 N, N m and J.
Normalization includes absolute summed contributions to handle cancellation.

loads_from_fluid_traction.documentation:
Convert sigma_f*n_f [nsegment,2] to net structural load.

t_structure=-t_fluid-p_external*n_f; pressure is absolute relative to
the same datum as p_external. External pressure and fluid forces remain
separate. Piecewise constant FV traction is integrated on overlap areas.

segment_endpoint_displacements.documentation:
Return [nsegment,2 endpoints,2] supported planar displacement.

Reject span dependence, out-of-plane motion and P1 kinks not resolved
by the fluid segments. This keeps the reduced trace and adjoint loads
consistent with exactly the same H, without nearest-point interpolation.

build_interface_map.parameters: *, segments_m: ArrayLike, fluid_normals: ArrayLike, width_m: float, structure: Mesh, facet_set: str, length_scale_m: float, span_origin_m: float=0.0, max_quadrature_points: int=200000
build_interface_map.documentation:
Build exact degree-two overlap quadrature and conservative P1 map.

Fluid segments [n,2,2] extrude over [span_origin,span_origin+width].
Structure must have named exterior Triangle3 facets owned by Tet4 cells;
outward structural normals must oppose the supplied fluid unit normals.
Geometric tolerance is 1e-10 Lref, relative area gate 1e-10. Gaps, double
coverage and unsupported geometry fail explicitly. No mesh generation/I/O.

build_domain_interface.parameters: domain: FluidDomain, *, wall_name: str, structure: Mesh, facet_set: str, length_scale_m: float, span_origin_m: float=0.0, max_quadrature_points: int=200000
build_domain_interface.documentation:
Build an overlap map from a named explicitly FSI-marked no-slip wall.

Segment order equals domain.mesh.boundary_sets[wall_name]. Tractions must
be selected from the solver's wall-row order into that same segment order.
Width is taken from FluidDomain, never guessed from structural coordinates.

fem_toolbox.coupling.structure.documentation: One-way interface load adapter to the existing verified Tet4 mechanics.

OneWayResult.documentation: Conservative loads and reference-geometry static structural response.

solve_one_way.parameters: mapping: InterfaceMap, model: Model, traction_Pa: ArrayLike, *, external_pressure_Pa: float=0.0
solve_one_way.documentation:
Apply sigma_f*n_f [nsegment,2] to a validated elasticity Model.

Existing body forces, tractions and prescribed displacements are preserved.
Forces are added through existing point-load DOFs; there is no new element
formulation. Structure mesh coordinates must equal the map coordinates.
Small-displacement and gradient bounds are both 0.02, as in Doc/71.

fem_toolbox.dynamic_result.documentation: Mesh-bound dynamic model result; keeps material/field export associations.

PiezoDynamicResult.documentation:
Dynamic solution bound to the exact mesh and effective cell materials.

solution is a modal result, transient history, or ordered tuple of harmonic
states. Provenance includes the resolved schema-3 document and solver hashes.

fem_toolbox.elements.elasticity.documentation: Linear Tet4 mechanical operators in engineering-shear Voigt convention.

strain_matrix.documentation: Return B (6,12), in 1/m, using the geometry's original node order.

stiffness_matrix.documentation: Return exactly integrated V B.T C B (12,12), in N/m.

fem_toolbox.elements.electrostatics.documentation: Exactly integrated Tet4 positive dielectric operator.

dielectric_matrix.documentation: Return V G.T k G (4,4), in F, in original local node order.

fem_toolbox.elements.heat.documentation: Exactly integrated Tet4 thermal conductance operator.

conductance_matrix.documentation: Return V G.T k G (4,4), in W/K, in original local node order.

fem_toolbox.elements.piezoelectric.documentation: Exactly integrated quasistatic piezoelectric Tet4 operators.

piezoelectric_matrix.documentation:
Return the signed symmetric (16,16) local tangent in [u(12), phi(4)] order.

With B (6,12), G (3,4), and volume V, the blocks are
``V B.T C B``, ``V B.T e.T G``, its transpose, and ``-V G.T kappa G``.
Mechanical rows have N/m for u columns and N/V for phi columns;
electric rows have C/m for u columns and C/V for phi columns. Invalid
geometry or material types raise ValidationError. Geometry itself validates
orientation and degeneracy on construction.

piezoelectric_thermal_load.parameters: geometry: Tet4Geometry, material: PiezoelectricMaterial, thermal_strain: ArrayLike, *, electric_thermal_strain: bool=False
piezoelectric_thermal_load.documentation:
Return local thermal RHS (16,) for a constant engineering-Voigt strain.

The mechanical part is ``V B.T C epsilon_th`` in N. If the explicit
electric switch is enabled, the electric part is ``V G.T e epsilon_th``
in C; otherwise it is exactly zero. This switch selects whether D uses
total strain or mechanical strain. The stiffness matrix is unchanged.

PiezoelectricElementResponse.documentation:
Constant fields and integrated electric enthalpy terms of one Tet4.

``strain`` uses engineering Voigt order (6,), ``electric_field`` and
``electric_displacement`` are (3,), and ``stress`` is (6,). Energies are
in J: mechanical, coupling, negative dielectric, and their sum.

piezoelectric_response.parameters: geometry: Tet4Geometry, material: PiezoelectricMaterial, displacement: ArrayLike, potential: ArrayLike, *, thermal_strain: ArrayLike | None=None, electric_thermal_strain: bool=False
piezoelectric_response.documentation:
Evaluate constant fields and integrated electric enthalpy for one Tet4.

``displacement`` has shape (4,3) in m, ``potential`` (4,) in V, and the
optional constant ``thermal_strain`` (6,) is dimensionless. If enabled,
D uses strain minus thermal strain; otherwise D uses total strain. In both
cases stress uses mechanical strain. Invalid shapes or a missing strain for
the enabled switch raise ValidationError.

fem_toolbox.elements.quadratic.documentation:
Constant-material, affine Tet10 operators; no global solver dispatch.

Node-major mechanics uses 30 DOFs, scalar fields 10, piezo [u(30), phi(10)].
Quadrature is exact for these polynomial integrands. All arrays retain input
node ordering. SI units and field signs follow the Tet4 contracts.

strain_matrix.documentation: B (6,30) in 1/m at physical point (3,), engineering Voigt yz,xz,xy.

conductance_matrix.documentation: Integral G.T k G (10,10), W/K; constant anisotropic conductivity.

dielectric_matrix.documentation: Positive integral G.T kappa G (10,10), F; piezo uses its negative.

stiffness_matrix.documentation: Integral B.T C B (30,30), N/m; constant engineering-Voigt stiffness.

piezoelectric_matrix.documentation:
Signed symmetric tangent (40,40), [u,phi], with +B.T e.T G coupling.

Mechanical block is integral B.T C B, dielectric block -G.T kappa G.
Units: N/m, N/V (C/m), C/V in the corresponding blocks. E=-grad(phi).

thermal_load.parameters: geometry: Tet10Geometry, material: ElasticMaterial | PiezoelectricMaterial, temperature: ArrayLike, expansion: ThermalExpansion, *, electric_thermal_strain: bool=False
thermal_load.documentation:
Thermal RHS (30,) N or (40,) [N,C] from nodal temperature (10,) K.

Integrates B.T C alpha*(N.T-Tref). For piezo, the explicit electric switch
adds G.T e alpha*(N.T-Tref), matching mechanical-strain D convention.
Default D uses total strain. No pyroelectricity or thermal feedback.
Constant expansion in engineering Voigt and reference temperature are SI.
Invalid geometry, material, temperature, expansion or switch raise ValidationError.

mass_matrix.parameters: geometry: Tet10Geometry, density: float, *, lumping: Lumping='consistent'
mass_matrix.documentation:
Mechanical (30,30) mass in kg; positive rho [kg/m³], no electric mass.

Default: exact rho Ni Nj tensor I3. 'hrz' scales the positive consistent
diagonal to conserve total mass per direction; not P1 row-sum lumping.

capacity_matrix.parameters: geometry: Tet10Geometry, density: float, specific_heat: float, *, lumping: Lumping='consistent'
capacity_matrix.documentation:
(10,10) capacity in J/K; positive rho [kg/m³], c [J/(kg K)].

'consistent' integrates rho c Ni Nj; explicit 'hrz' conserves total capacity
by scaling its positive diagonal. Invalid or unrepresentable values fail.

fem_toolbox.elements.quadrature.documentation: Positive reference simplex quadrature by a collapsed Gauss product.

QuadratureRule.documentation:
Points (n, d), weights (n,) and guaranteed total polynomial degree.

Reference weights integrate d-dimensional reference measure (1/6 for a
tetrahedron, 1/2 for a triangle). Geometry methods return physical points
in metres and weights in m³ or m². Arrays returned by the factory functions
and geometry methods are immutable. No normalization to unit weight.

tetrahedron_quadrature.documentation:
64 positive points on x,y,z >= 0, x+y+z <= 1; exact through degree 5.

Four Gauss points per collapsed coordinate integrate degrees up to seven;
the Jacobian adds at most two powers, giving total simplex degree five.
This includes degree-four products of quadratic shape functions.

triangle_quadrature.documentation: Nine positive points on x,y >= 0, x+y <= 1; exact through degree 4.

fem_toolbox.elements.storage.documentation: Exactly integrated, constant-coefficient Tet4 storage operators.

mass_matrix.parameters: geometry: Tet4Geometry, density: float, *, lumped: bool=False
mass_matrix.documentation:
Return mechanical mass (12,12) in kg, node-major xyz local order.

Density is constant on the element, finite and positive in kg/m³.
The default integrates rho Ni Nj exactly; lumped=True selects row-sum
lumping. Invalid inputs or unrepresentable storage raise ValidationError.
Electrical DOFs carry no mass and are not part of this operator.

capacity_matrix.parameters: geometry: Tet4Geometry, density: float, specific_heat: float, *, lumped: bool=False
capacity_matrix.documentation:
Return thermal capacity (4,4) in J/K in original local node order.

Density [kg/m³] and specific_heat [J/(kg K)] must be finite positive
constants on this element. Default: exact integral rho c Ni Nj;
lumped=True selects row-sum lumping. Invalid inputs and unrepresentable
storage raise ValidationError. No temperature dependence is implied.

fem_toolbox.elements.tet10.documentation: Quadratic Lagrange interpolation on affine tetrahedra and planar triangles.

Tet10Face.documentation: Six outward-oriented local nodes, opposite corner and affine face data.

Tet10Geometry.documentation:
Straight Tet10 with VTK node order: corners then 01,12,20,03,13,23.

Coordinates are (10,3) in metres. Shape values and point-dependent physical
gradients retain input ordering, including negative orientation. Curved or
non-midpoint edges are rejected at relative edge tolerance 1e-10. Corner
degeneracy uses the Tet4 dimensionless criterion. Evaluation outside the
element is polynomial extrapolation, not an inclusion test.

__init__.parameters: self, coordinates: ArrayLike, *, entity_id: int | None=None, degeneracy_tolerance: float=DEFAULT_DEGENERACY_TOLERANCE

signed_volume.documentation: Signed volume of the input corner ordering in m³.

quality.documentation: Affine corner-simplex quality, independent of interpolation degree.

oriented_node_order.documentation: Ten-node permutation giving positive corner orientation.

oriented_coordinates.documentation: Immutable coordinates consistently permuted to positive orientation.

oriented_connectivity.documentation: Permute ten unique integer indices with the geometry; retain IDs.

shape_values.documentation: Ten dimensionless shape values at a physical (3,) point in metres.

shape_gradients.documentation: Physical gradients (10,3), one row per input node, in 1/m.

quadrature.documentation: Physical points and positive m³ weights, exact through degree five.

Triangle6Geometry.documentation:
Planar straight Triangle6: corners 0,1,2 then edge nodes 01,12,20.

Coordinates are (6,3) in metres; input corner order defines the normal.
Gradients are tangential vectors in ambient 3D. Off-plane evaluation is
rejected at 1e-10 of the maximum edge length. In-plane extrapolation is
allowed. Curved edges and relative area <= 1e-12 are rejected.

__init__.parameters: self, coordinates: ArrayLike

unit_normal.documentation: Immutable unit normal following the input corner ordering.

shape_values.documentation: Six dimensionless values at a physical (3,) point in the plane.

shape_gradients.documentation: Tangential physical gradients (6,3) in 1/m, in input node order.

quadrature.documentation: Physical points and m² weights, exact through degree four.

fem_toolbox.elements.tet4.documentation: Geometry operators and quality measures for the linear tetrahedron.

Tet4Face.documentation: Geometry of one face, identified by local nodes and opposite node.

Tet4Quality.documentation: Permutation-, rotation-, translation-, and scale-invariant quality data.

Tet4Geometry.documentation:
Validated constant geometry operators for one Tet4 element.

``shape_gradients`` stores one physical gradient per node in a ``(4, 3)``
array. ``gradient_matrix`` exposes the equivalent FEM convention ``G`` with
shape ``(3, 4)``. The raw signed volume retains the input orientation;
``oriented_node_order`` and ``oriented_coordinates`` provide a positive
orientation without mutating the input.

__init__.parameters: self, coordinates: ArrayLike, *, entity_id: int | None=None, degeneracy_tolerance: float=DEFAULT_DEGENERACY_TOLERANCE

coordinates.documentation: Immutable input coordinates with shape ``(4, 3)`` in metres.

entity_id.documentation: Optional mesh entity ID used in diagnostics.

signed_volume.documentation: Oriented input volume in cubic metres.

volume.documentation: Positive element volume in cubic metres.

shape_gradients.documentation: Constant physical gradients as rows ``[grad(N_0), ..., grad(N_3)]``.

oriented_node_order.documentation: Local permutation that yields a positive orientation.

faces.documentation:
Four outward faces, computed on first access and retained per instance.

Volume-only operations do not construct faces. The unchanged geometric
calculation uses owned immutable coordinates; no external invalidation
or shared cache is needed. Concurrent first access may duplicate work.

shape_values.documentation: Evaluate the four affine shape functions at a physical point.

oriented_connectivity.documentation: Return four node indices permuted consistently with the geometry.

ThermalNullspaceError.documentation:
An unanchored connected thermal component has a constant null mode.

compatible identifies a balanced Neumann problem with an undetermined

Unreferenced electrical component: compatible free gauge or charge defect.

net_charge = volume charge minus prescribed outward D-flux, in C.
tolerance is in C; component is the zero-based connected-component index.

DofMap.documentation: Allocate exactly the supplied fields in input order, without padding.

__init__.parameters: self, fields: Sequence[Field]

Write into a new directory; existing paths are never overwritten.

Pass write as solve_transient_heat(on_frame=writer.write), then call
finish(result). Failures leave a readable series marked incomplete.
Probe/balance CSV and final provenance are published only on finish.
Inactive mesh nodes/triangle fields are zero-filled with validity masks.

__init__.parameters: self, path: str | Path, mesh: Mesh

finish.documentation: Mark a matching completed run after writing all probe/balance records.

fem_toolbox.io.meshio_adapter.documentation: Gmsh and VTU adapters implemented at the meshio infrastructure boundary.

read_gmsh.documentation:
Read one Tet4/Triangle3 or straight Tet10/Triangle6 Gmsh family.

Coordinates are multiplied by ``length_scale_to_m`` and stored in metres.
Physical names become immutable volume or facet selection sets. Gmsh 4.1
entities belonging to several physical groups remain in every corresponding
set, while the singular compatibility tags retain meshio's first physical tag.
Negative volume orientations are normalized, including all Tet10 edge nodes.
Curved quadratic geometry and degenerate volume cells are rejected.

read_vtu.documentation:
Read mesh topology and Toolbox metadata from VTU, without changing ordering.

Restores optional IDs, tags and overlapping/empty sets written by write_vtu.
Result arrays remain accessible through meshio; this function returns Mesh.

write_vtu.parameters: path: str | Path, mesh: Mesh, *, point_data: Mapping[str, ArrayLike] | None=None, cell_data: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, ArrayLike]] | None=None, binary: bool=True
write_vtu.documentation:
Write a mesh and numeric result arrays to an unstructured VTK file.

Every cell result field must provide arrays for all non-empty internal cell
types, keyed by the active ``tetra4``/``triangle3`` or ``tetra10``/``triangle6`` family. Selection sets are
exported as independent ``fem_toolbox:set:<name>`` masks, so overlapping
memberships remain lossless in the VTU output.

fem_toolbox.io.piezo_series.documentation: Mesh-bound piezo fields/probes, preserving complex frequency-domain data.

export_piezo_series.parameters: path: str | Path, result: ModelResult, *, probes: Mapping[str, int | ArrayLike] | None=None
export_piezo_series.documentation:
Write a new directory with PVD/VTU fields, probe CSV and manifest.

Requires a schema-3 ModelResult bound to its solved mesh/materials. Probe
locations are mesh node indices or points (3,) m inside Tet4/Tet10 cells.
Interpolate
complex u/v/a/phi before computing amplitude/phase. Cell strain/stress/E/D
are unsmoothed Tet4 constants or explicitly labelled Tet10 centroid samples.
Inactive nodes/facets are zero-filled with
validity masks. Amplitude and phase are componentwise (peak, radians);
zero amplitude has phase=0 and phase_valid=0. Real modes/transients only
emit *_real, never a fictitious phase.

ParaView's collection coordinate is time_s, frequency_hz or mode_index,
explicitly distinguished in the manifest. Modal vectors are mass-normalized
shapes, not physical amplitudes. Existing directories are never overwritten;
an interrupted export remains marked incomplete with its completed frames.

fem_toolbox.io.result_bundle.documentation: Versioned raw SI result export for stationary Tet4 analyses.

export_result_bundle.parameters: path: str | Path, mesh: Mesh, result: object
export_result_bundle.documentation:
Write `<path>.vtu` and `<path>.json` with raw SI fields and metrics.

The destination parent must exist; existing output files are never replaced.
Fields are staged first and rolled back if final publication fails. Inactive
mesh nodes are zero padded in VTU and listed by active ID in the manifest.

fem_toolbox.materials.documentation: Validated, immutable material parameters in global axes.

ElasticMaterial.documentation:
Symmetric positive-definite 6x6 stiffness in Pa.

Voigt order is xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy with engineering shear strains.
Anisotropic data must already be expressed in the global coordinate frame.
Symmetry tolerance is 1e-12 times the largest coefficient; accepted rounding
asymmetry is averaged. Eigenvalues <= 1e-12 times the largest eigenvalue are
rejected as numerically unstable. Storage is copied onto immutable bytes.

__init__.parameters: self, stiffness: ArrayLike

isotropic.documentation:
Construct from Young's modulus (Pa) and Poisson ratio (dimensionless).

Requires E > 0 and -1 < nu < 0.49; nearly incompressible Tet4 inputs are
rejected to avoid presenting a locking-prone formulation as suitable.

ThermalExpansion.documentation:
Global engineering-Voigt expansion (6,) in 1/K and reference T in K.

Material-axis tensors must be rotated into global axes by the caller.
``source_axes`` records the local-to-global rotation only for values
constructed through ``from_principal``; direct inputs are already global.

__init__.parameters: self, alpha: ArrayLike, reference_temperature: float

from_principal.parameters: cls, principal_alpha: ArrayLike, reference_temperature: float, axes: ArrayLike
from_principal.documentation: Rotate principal expansion (3,) in 1/K; axes columns are local axes.

fem_toolbox.materials.catalog.documentation:
Small versioned thermal parameter library from identified primary sources.

Typical room-temperature constants, not temperature-dependent constitutive laws.
See Doc/32_MATERIAL_LIBRARY.md for source tables, conversions and limitations.

ThermalPreset.documentation: SI scalar data: density kg/m³, specific_heat J/(kg K), conductivity W/(m K).

thermal_material.documentation: Build an immutable isotropic material with storage and source metadata.

material_catalog.documentation: Return the immutable version-1 preset catalog (no network access).

thermal_material.documentation: Build a preset by exact key; unknown names raise ValidationError.

fem_toolbox.materials.electrostatics.documentation: Constant anisotropic absolute dielectric permittivity in global Cartesian axes.

DielectricMaterial.documentation:
Immutable symmetric positive-definite (3,3) permittivity in F/m.

Symmetry tolerance is 1e-12 times the largest coefficient. Accepted roundoff
asymmetry is averaged; eigenvalue ratios <= 1e-12 are rejected. Input arrays
are copied. Material-axis rotation and field dependence are not implicit.

__init__.parameters: self, permittivity: ArrayLike

isotropic.documentation: Construct from a positive finite scalar permittivity in F/m.

fem_toolbox.materials.heat.documentation: Constant anisotropic thermal conductivity in global Cartesian axes.

ThermalSource.documentation: Traceable preset identity and source; no claim of a validity interval.

ThermalMaterial.documentation:
Immutable symmetric positive-definite (3,3) conductivity in W/(m K).

Optional density [kg/m³] and specific_heat [J/(kg K)] must be supplied
together, finite and positive, for transient analysis.

Symmetry tolerance is 1e-12 times the largest coefficient. Accepted roundoff
asymmetry is averaged; eigenvalue ratios <= 1e-12 are rejected. Input arrays
are copied. Material-axis rotation and temperature dependence are not implicit.

__init__.parameters: self, conductivity: ArrayLike, *, density: float | None=None, specific_heat: float | None=None, source: ThermalSource | None=None

isotropic.documentation: Construct from a positive finite scalar conductivity in W/(m K).

fem_toolbox.materials.piezoelectric.documentation: Linear piezoelectric material in the project's stress-charge convention.

PiezoelectricMaterial.documentation:
Immutable stress-charge tensors in global Cartesian axes.

``stiffness`` is C^E (6,6) Pa, ``stress_coupling`` is e (3,6) C/m²,
and ``permittivity`` is kappa^S (3,3) F/m. Strain uses engineering shear
and Voigt order xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy. Electric components are x, y, z.
The constitutive laws are sigma=C^E epsilon-e.T E and
D=e epsilon+kappa^S E. ``axes`` columns are local basis vectors in global
coordinates; omitted axes mean input tensors already use global axes.
Invalid shape, symmetry, stability, axes, or nonfinite data raise
ValidationError. All arrays are owned read-only copies.

__init__.parameters: self, stiffness: ArrayLike, stress_coupling: ArrayLike, permittivity: ArrayLike, *, axes: ArrayLike | None=None

from_strain_charge.parameters: cls, compliance: ArrayLike, strain_coupling: ArrayLike, permittivity_at_stress: ArrayLike, *, axes: ArrayLike | None=None
from_strain_charge.documentation:
Convert s^E (1/Pa), d (C/N), kappa^T (F/m) to stress-charge.

Requires both s^E and the resulting kappa^S = kappa^T-d C^E d.T
to be positive definite. Conversion uses linear solves, not an explicit
inverse, and retains the supplied local tensors in provenance.

as_strain_charge.documentation: Return detached global s^E, d, kappa^T tensors in SI units.

to_provenance_dict.documentation: Return detached JSON-compatible local inputs and global tensors.

fem_toolbox.materials.regions.documentation: Resolve named volume sets to typed, traceable cell materials.

MaterialAssignment.documentation: Per-cell materials and provenance in input volume-cell row order.

to_provenance_dict.documentation: Return JSON-safe effective cell mapping and SI material tensors.

assign_region_materials.parameters: mesh: Mesh, field: str, regions: Mapping[str, str], materials: Mapping[str, Material]
assign_region_materials.documentation:
Map named volume sets onto all volume cells before field assembly.

``field`` is ``T``, ``u``, ``phi``, ``piezo`` or ``expansion``. Every
region names one catalog entry of the matching immutable SI material type.
Overlapping sets are allowed only when they name the same catalog entry.
Unknown sets/materials, uncovered cells, conflicts and unused definitions
raise :class:`MaterialAssignmentError` with the external volume-cell ID where
applicable. Existing solvers accept ``cell_materials`` directly.

fem_toolbox.mesh.model.documentation: Validated topology and selection storage for three-dimensional meshes.

Mesh.documentation:
Immutable topology for one Tet4/Triangle3 or Tet10/Triangle6 family.

Connectivity and selections always contain zero-based internal indices.
Optional external IDs remain separate so importer-specific numbering cannot
leak into numerical kernels. Inputs are copied into read-only canonical
``float64`` and ``int64`` arrays.

fem_toolbox.mesh.quadratic.documentation: Quadratic simplex node ordering and conforming edge incidence (no operators).

edge_nodes.documentation: Map endpoint IDs to midpoint IDs in VTK/meshio local ordering.

validate_edge_incidence.documentation: Reject hanging/duplicated edge DOFs and a midpoint reused as a vertex.

require_straight.documentation:
Require mid-edge coordinates within 1e-10 of each local edge length.

Compare relative coordinates so absolute translation does not relax the
tolerance. Curved geometry needs separate quadrature and is unsupported.

reordered_tet10.documentation: Transport all six edge nodes with a corner permutation.

fem_toolbox.mesh.refinement.documentation: Deterministic conforming edge-star bisection for affine Tet4 meshes.

Refinement.documentation: Child-to-input row maps; external IDs are deliberately not reused.

validate_tet4.documentation: Require nonempty, complete affine Tet4 topology and nondegenerate cells.

refine_tet4.parameters: mesh: Mesh, marked: ArrayLike, *, max_points: int | None=None
refine_tet4.documentation:
Bisect each marked cell's longest edge, including its entire edge star.

Edges are chosen on the INPUT mesh, ties by sorted node pair, processed in
sorted order. Every incident volume and boundary simplex is split at the same
midpoint, so no hanging nodes arise. Closure may refine unmarked cells.
Cell/facet tags and overlapping named sets are inherited via parent rows.
Geometry and material interfaces are preserved exactly for straight elements.
No smoothing, coarsening, curved surfaces or uniform shape-quality bound.
max_points limits active thermal DOFs; exceeded budget leaves input untouched.
External IDs are removed: child identity is given by the returned parent maps.

validate_refinement.documentation:
Reject invalid parentage, domain changes and lost physical groups.

Children must lie in their parent simplex; summed child measures must equal
each parent measure. Together with complete conforming boundary topology this
checks the edge-bisection adapter contract, not arbitrary mesh intersection.

fem_toolbox.mesh.topology.documentation: Deterministic simplex incidence and matching surface preflight.

BoundaryFace.documentation:
Exterior face, oriented away from its unique tetrahedral owner.

``cell_index`` and ``triangle_index`` are zero-based rows; IDs retain the
imported entity numbers where present. ``triangle_index`` is absent for an
exterior face with no surface entry.

BoundaryTopology.documentation: Preflight result with stable canonical order and triangle-row lookup.

inspect_boundary_topology.documentation:
Validate each surface simplex against the unique exterior volume incidence.

Set ``require_complete`` when every exterior volume face must have a
surface row. Partial boundary meshes remain valid by default. Named
groups may overlap; conflicting boundary conditions belong to Model
validation, where their physical meaning is known.

fem_toolbox.model.documentation: Strict TOML/Python adapter for stationary and transient heat workflows.

VolumeLoad.documentation:
Integrate one Tet4 volume contribution, including its weak-form sign.

cell is a zero-based mesh.tetra4 row. Returned values are integrated SI
equation loads; the adapter owns quadrature, field and material conventions.

integrate.parameters: self, mesh: Mesh, cell: int, dofs: DofMap
integrate.documentation: Return local global-DOF indices and integrated values.

SurfaceLoad.documentation:
Integrate one Triangle3 load; facet is a zero-based mesh.triangle3 row.

The implementation owns outward orientation and weak-form sign, as well as
quadrature. No universal thermal/electric sign is imposed by assembly.

integrate.parameters: self, mesh: Mesh, facet: int, dofs: DofMap
integrate.documentation: Return local global-DOF indices and integrated SI equation loads.

fem_toolbox.physics.elasticity.documentation: Consistent mechanical loads; vectors are in global Cartesian axes.

body_load.documentation:
Integrate body force (N/m³) to a (12,) nodal force vector (N).

Constant forces are exact; callables receive x (3,) in metres. Four-point
degree-two tetrahedral quadrature is exact for affine force distributions.
More general spatial loads require a separate quadrature convergence check.

traction_load.documentation:
Integrate prescribed global traction (N/m²) on Triangle3 to (9,) N.

No pressure/normal sign is inferred. Swapping triangle orientation only
permutes nodal forces. Three-point degree-two quadrature integrates affine
tractions exactly. Degenerate triangles and invalid vectors are rejected.

fem_toolbox.physics.electrostatics.documentation: Charge integrals for -K_phi phi = surface(D.n) - volume(rho).

volume_charge_load.documentation:
Return -integral N rho (4,) C; rho in C/m³, callable x (3,) in m.

Four-point degree-two quadrature integrates affine density exactly.

surface_charge_load.documentation:
Return +integral N omega (3,) C; omega = D.n_out in C/m².

omega is the outward dielectric displacement, not the opposite-signed free
charge on an adjacent conductor. Three-point degree-two triangle quadrature
integrates affine density exactly, independent of triangle orientation.

fem_toolbox.physics.heat.documentation: Thermal sources, outward fluxes and linear Robin boundary integration.

source_load.documentation:
Integrate Q (W/m³, positive heat generation) to (4,) nodal power in W.

Callables receive x (3,) in metres. Degree-two four-point quadrature is
exact for affine sources. Higher variation requires quadrature verification.

flux_load.documentation:
Return -(integral N q_out) (3,) W; q_out in W/m² is positive OUTWARD.

Uses degree-two triangle quadrature; exact for affine fluxes. The sign is
independent of triangle node ordering because q_out is a prescribed scalar.

Convection.documentation:
Robin law q_out=h*(T-T_inf): h >= 0 in W/(m² K), ambient in K.

h is constant on a facet; ambient is a finite scalar or spatial callable.
Temperature and ambient use the same reference (absolute K by default).

convection_terms.documentation:
Return boundary conductance (3,3) W/K and ambient load (3,) W.

Constant h gives the exact consistent triangle mass matrix. The load is
integrated at degree two, exact for affine ambient temperatures.

fem_toolbox.physics.quadratic.documentation:
Tet10 and Triangle6 source/boundary integrals with existing SI field signs.

Materials are constant; spatial load callables receive a physical (3,) point in
metres. Volume rules integrate degree-five polynomials, surface rules degree four.
Thus loads are exact through degree three in volume and degree two on surfaces.
More general callables require separate quadrature convergence verification.

source_load.documentation: Integral N Q (10,) W; positive generation Q in W/m³.

body_load.documentation: Integral N body force (30,) N; Cartesian force density in N/m³.

volume_charge_load.documentation: Negative integral N rho (10,) C; charge density in C/m³.

flux_load.documentation: Negative integral N q_out (6,) W; outward heat flux in W/m².

surface_charge_load.documentation:
Positive integral N (D.n_out) (6,) C; input in C/m².

Adjacent conductor charge has the opposite sign. Orientation never changes
the sign of a supplied scalar boundary datum.

traction_load.documentation: Integral N prescribed Cartesian traction (18,) N; datum in N/m².

convection_terms.documentation:
Boundary conductance (6,6) W/K and ambient load (6,) W, h>=0.

Existing Convection carries constant h [W/(m² K)] and ambient K. Matrix is
exactly integrated; ambient polynomials through degree two are exact.

HeatIndicator.documentation:
Cell-row indicators sqrt(W K), squared contributions W K, global l2 norm.

Arrays own immutable storage. Interior-face contributions are divided equally
between their two owners. This is a heuristic energy-error indicator, without
reliability/efficiency constants or robustness guarantees for high contrast.

cell.documentation: Local indicator eta_K in sqrt(W K), ordered as mesh.tetra4.

total.documentation: Global indicator sqrt(sum_K eta_K²) in sqrt(W K).

mark_bulk.documentation:
Minimal-cardinality Dörfler set capturing fraction of sum eta_K².

Nonnegative finite eta_K; 0 < fraction <= 1. Ties favor lower cell rows;
returned rows are sorted ascending. Zero total gives an empty set. Rescaling
before squaring avoids overflow/underflow under a common unit-scale change.
No numerical noise cutoff is inferred from dimensional values.

heat_indicator.parameters: mesh: Mesh, temperature: ArrayLike, material: ThermalMaterial | Sequence[ThermalMaterial], *, source: ScalarField=0.0, dirichlet_facets: Iterable[int]=(), outward_fluxes: Mapping[int, ScalarField] | None=None, convection: Mapping[int, Convection] | None=None
heat_indicator.documentation:
Estimate stationary Tet4 heat energy error from full-mesh nodal T (K).

Temperature has shape (mesh.n_points,). Conductivity is cellwise constant,
symmetric positive definite, in W/(m K). Source Q is W/m³, prescribed outward
flux W/m². Boundary arguments address triangle3 rows; full exterior coverage
is mandatory. Explicit Dirichlet facets have no residual term; other facets
default to insulation. Flux and Robin terms add, as in solve_heat. Dirichlet
cannot overlap either. Caller must supply the actual problem's boundary data.

eta_K² = h_K²/lambda_K * integral_K Q²
  + 1/2 sum_inner h_F/lambda_F * integral_F jump(q.n)²
  + sum_N/R h_F/lambda_K * integral_F (q.n-q_pres-h*(T-T_inf))².
h denotes diameter, lambda_K=min eig(k_K), lambda_F=min of adjacent values.
q=-k grad(T_h); div(q)=0 inside affine Tet4 cells. Volume degree-5 and surface
degree-4 quadrature integrate squared residuals; nonpolynomial data require
separate quadrature assessment. Norm targets sqrt(integral grad(e).k.grad(e))
with units sqrt(W K); no certified error bound, data-oscillation correction,
transient, coupled, Tet10 or automatic remeshing support is implied.

Limits are finite and strictly increasing; clipped colors have colorbar

Angles are elevation/azimuth in degrees; size is in inches. No show(),

fem_toolbox.solvers.elasticity.documentation: Static small-strain elasticity with a SciPy sparse direct reference solve.

mechanical_dofs.documentation:
Allocate u=(x,y,z) on sorted active Tet4/Tet10 node indices, in metres.

Mesh points unused by volume cells receive no displacement DOFs.

ElasticResult.documentation:
Raw, immutable results in active-node / input-cell order.

node_ids: (nactive,) mesh indices; displacement: (nactive,3) m;
strain/stress: (ncells,6), total engineering Voigt strain and Pa stress;
Tet4 strain/stress are cell constants (field_points=None); Tet10 uses raw
centroid samples located by field_points (ncells,3) in metres.
element_energy: (ncells,) integrated mechanical-strain energy J;
reactions/applied_loads/residual: (nactive,3) N.
Reactions are zero at free DOFs; residual retains their equilibrium error.
force_balance (3,) N and moment_balance (3,) N m include external loads and
reactions. relative_residual is the free residual norm divided by
|| |K| |u| + |f| || (zero for an exactly unloaded state). This backward-error
scale remains meaningful for rigid motions with cancelling internal forces.

solve_elasticity.parameters: mesh: Mesh, material: ElasticMaterial | Sequence[ElasticMaterial], conditions: Iterable[Dirichlet], *, backend: LinearBackend | None=None, body_force: VectorField=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), tractions: Mapping[int, VectorField] | None=None, point_loads: Mapping[int, ArrayLike] | None=None, expansion: ThermalExpansion | Sequence[ThermalExpansion] | None=None, temperature: ArrayLike | None=None
solve_elasticity.documentation:
Solve static linear elasticity on Tet4 or straight Tet10 cells, in SI units.

``backend`` is an experimental linear-backend hook; None selects SciPy.
Reduction, physical residuals and result units remain this solver's contract.

material is homogeneous or one material per input cell. conditions use
mechanical_dofs(mesh); nonzero displacement values are allowed. tractions
maps boundary triangle row indices to global traction vectors/callables.
point_loads maps active mesh node indices to forces (3,) N. Contributions
add, including loads on prescribed DOFs. No pressure or follower loads.

Invalid materials, loads, conflicting conditions, missing supports and
numerically singular systems raise ValidationError. Optional temperature is
nodal absolute K; expansion may be homogeneous or per input cell. The thermal
eigenstrain for Tet4 is alpha times the cell-average temperature difference.
Tet10 interpolates temperature quadratically at quadrature points for thermal
loads and mechanical-strain energy. Reported eigenstrain/stress is sampled
at the centroid, not obtained from an arithmetic nodal average.
Tet10 body/surface quadrature has degree five/four; Tet4 degree two.
Diagonally equilibrated LU rejects relative pivots <= 1e-12; very poorly
conditioned models require reformulation rather than a silent solution.

fem_toolbox.solvers.electrostatics.documentation: Electrostatic Tet4/Tet10 reference solver, preserving the negative electric block.

electric_dofs.documentation: Allocate phi (V) on sorted active Tet4/Tet10 nodes, without unused DOFs.

ElectrostaticResult.documentation:
Immutable nodal and raw element results in SI.

node_ids (nactive,) map potential (nactive,) V to mesh nodes. electric_field
and electric_displacement (ncells,3) are E=-grad(phi) V/m and D=kappa E C/m².
Tet4 fields are elementwise constant (field_points=None); Tet10 fields are
raw centroid samples located by field_points (ncells,3) in metres.
element_energy (ncells,) integrates positive stored energy (J) over each
entire cell, not electric enthalpy or energy evaluated at its centroid.
reactions and residual (nactive,) are C for the ORIGINAL negative electric
equation. reactions are unknown outward D-flux contributions at fixed DOFs
(zero on free DOFs). Adjacent conductor charges are their NEGATIVE.
volume_charge, prescribed_surface_charge and dirichlet_outward_charge are C.
charge_balance = prescribed surface + Dirichlet outward - volume charge.
relative_residual = ||r_free|| / || |A| |phi| + |f| ||, A=-K_phi.

energy.documentation: Total stored electrostatic field energy in J.

solve_electrostatics.parameters: mesh: Mesh, material: DielectricMaterial | Sequence[DielectricMaterial], conditions: Iterable[Dirichlet], *, backend: LinearBackend | None=None, volume_charge: ChargeDensity=0.0, surface_charges: Mapping[int, ChargeDensity] | None=None
solve_electrostatics.documentation:
Solve div(D)=rho, D=-kappa grad(phi), with the negative electric block.

``backend`` is an experimental linear-backend hook; None selects SciPy.
Reduction, physical residuals and result units remain this solver's contract.

Permittivity is homogeneous or one material per input cell (absolute F/m).
Dirichlet DOFs use electric_dofs(mesh). volume_charge is rho C/m³; surface
mappings address exterior triangle rows and prescribe omega=D.n_out C/m²,
not adjacent conductor charge. Callables receive x (3,) m. Tet4 load rules
have degree two; Tet10 volume/surface rules have degree five/four. Only
straight Tet10 is supported. Unspecified boundaries have D.n=0.

Each connected component needs a supplied potential reference. Missing gauges
raise ElectricGaugeError before factorization; no automatic pinning occurs.
Invalid input, conditioning or failed residual/charge balance raises
ValidationError. No piezoelectric coupling or floating electrodes.

fem_toolbox.solvers.heat.documentation: Stationary thermal reference solver with explicit outward-power convention.

thermal_dofs.documentation: One T DOF per sorted active Tet4/Tet10 mesh node, in K; no unused-node DOFs.

HeatResult.documentation:
Immutable raw thermal results with explicit SI units.

node_ids (nactive,) map temperature (nactive,) K back to the mesh.
gradient/heat_flux (ncells,3) are K/m and W/m² in input cell order.
Tet4 values are elementwise constant (field_points=None). Tet10 values are
raw centroid samples; field_points (ncells,3) gives their physical locations
in metres. They are neither nodal projections nor constant Tet10 fields.
reactions/residual (nactive,) are W; reaction is zero on free DOFs and
positive for heat supplied by a prescribed-temperature reservoir.
source_power, prescribed_outflow, convection_outflow, dirichlet_inflow and
power_balance are W. Balance = source + Dirichlet - prescribed - convection.
relative_residual is the free residual norm / || |K| |T| + |f| ||.
provenance records the effective discrete model, not callable source code.

solve_heat.parameters: mesh: Mesh, material: ThermalMaterial | Sequence[ThermalMaterial], conditions: Iterable[Dirichlet], *, backend: LinearBackend | None=None, source: ScalarField=0.0, outward_fluxes: Mapping[int, ScalarField] | None=None, convection: Mapping[int, Convection] | None=None
solve_heat.documentation:
Solve -div(k grad T)=Q on a homogeneous Tet4 or straight Tet10 mesh with SI data.

``backend`` is an experimental linear-backend hook; None selects SciPy.
Reduction, physical residuals and result units remain this solver's contract.

Material is homogeneous or one per input cell. Dirichlet indices come from
thermal_dofs(mesh). Surface mappings address exterior triangle row indices.
Positive outward flux removes heat. Robin law is q_out=h*(T-T_inf); surface
contributions may add (including prescribed flux on a convecting surface).
Tet4 load quadrature is degree two; Tet10 volume/surface rules are degree
five/four. Temperatures share
the same reference, normally absolute kelvin; no reference is invented.

ValidationError rejects invalid input, singularity or failed residual/balance
checks. ThermalNullspaceError diagnoses each first unanchored component as
compatible or incompatible before sparse factorization. Pure Neumann systems
are not automatically pinned, even when compatible. No transient coupling.

fem_toolbox.solvers.linear_backend.documentation:
Internal linear backend boundary; physical reduction stays with adapters.

Operators are free, electrode-condensed systems in their original SI units.
Fields partition their local rows; scale is positive real, x=S*y and SAS*y=S*b.
Multiple RHS columns and real/complex data are supported without scalar loss.

SolveReport.documentation:
Unscaled residuals; each norm ratio uses || |A||x|+|b| || on that field.

Matrix RHS uses the Frobenius norm. Residual has RHS shape and equation
units (N, W or signed C as supplied). Direct methods have no iterations.
Failure raises ValidationError rather than returning a false success.

LinearSolution.documentation: Owned immutable solution and residual report in original unknown units.

solve.documentation: Solve finite (n,) or (n,nrhs) RHS; reject invalid or failed solves.

fem_toolbox.solvers.petsc_backend.documentation:
Optional one-process PETSc direct and FieldSplit backends, imported only on selection.

A real PETSc build handles complex operators by exact real block embedding and
complex RHS for real operators by two solves. Field residuals use the original
complex system. MPI-distributed solves are outside the supported scope.

PetscBackend.documentation:
Experimental native sequential LU; requires petsc4py and double PETSc.

Instantiation diagnoses missing/incompatible installations. Importing this
module does not load petsc4py. Factors may be reused and explicitly closed;
finalization also releases their native resources. No PETSc options database
is read by the solver and no alternative factor package is selected.

PetscFieldSplitBackend.documentation:
FGMRES with full Schur block factorization and A11 preconditioning.

Two nonempty fields use native FieldSplit with explicit local index sets;
a single remaining field uses LU preconditioning. Both block inverses are
native sequential LU. Physical adapters must remove rigid/gauge nullspaces;
no loads are projected and no missing boundary conditions are invented.
Tolerances apply to the scaled KSP residual; original field residuals must
additionally satisfy the shared contract. Limits apply per native RHS solve.
